description: This file defines the EmployeeEducation entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing an employee's educational background with mappings to a database via Doctrine ORM annotations.

classes.name: EmployeeEducation
classes.description: Entity class representing an employee's education record, including references to employee and education details, as well as specific institution, major, year, score, start and end dates.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the education record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the education record.

methods.name: setEducation
methods.description: Associates an Education entity with this employee education record.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee entity associated with this education record.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with this education record.

methods.name: getInstitute
methods.description: Returns the name of the institute where the education was obtained.

methods.name: setInstitute
methods.description: Sets the name of the institute.

methods.name: getMajor
methods.description: Returns the major field of study.

methods.name: setMajor
methods.description: Sets the major field of study.

methods.name: getYear
methods.description: Returns the year of graduation or completion.

methods.name: setYear
methods.description: Sets the year of graduation or completion.

methods.name: getScore
methods.description: Returns the score or grade obtained.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the education period.

methods.name: setStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the education period.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the education period.

methods.name: setEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the education period.
